scope.knownGeneralityLimit: The prototype guard is fixed at [-512,2560] on both axes and intersections use host long double. It is not valid evidence for other target extents or CPU ABIs.

ownerOnly.verdict: Bypassing native clipping and fragment invocation alone is byte-identical to production and does not close the 50-pixel gap.

algorithm: Retain the original native geometry draw and base axis table.
Canonical-clip public source triangles in source order and append only children accepted by the public raster constructor.
Resolve the center owner with last-appended-slot-wins semantics.
For a base-owned center, restrict center/XOR partner lookup to base owners.
For a child-owned center, lock center/XOR samples to that selected child slot, falling back to its selected geometric primitive when a partner is outside the active child half.

benchmark256.note: The duplicate-base-free interposer still constructs supported and unsupported child setups separately. That CPU work dominates the RX 9070 overhead; a production batch constructor is required before judging final cost.

retainedSetupBoundary.verdict: No retained public-input-only arbitrary non-axis postclip setup law is executable. Unsupported children must retain base output explicitly; approximation is not authorized.

validation.computeSnapshotIndependentAudit: pass as an output-blind corpus prototype; rejected as a production interposer

blockers: Replace fixed 2048 guard planes with per-axis NDC guard bounds -extent/4 and 5*extent/4.
Replace host long-double interpolation with exact finite-binary32 rational interpolation and one explicit round-to-nearest-even result.
Support every 0..7-vertex clipped polygon and fan children in stable source order.
Use a typed batch-construction status so only known unsupported setup retains base output; allocation, bounds, capacity, and malformed geometry fail closed.
Pass public geometry directly and use renderer-owned per-context resources rather than GL-call interception.
Move expanded owner metadata to a capacity-safe texture or storage buffer unless a smaller bound is formally proven across target sizes.
Add provenance that hashes the expanded renderer/shader/environment before replacing the frozen 141 baseline.

productionPatchMap: Extend parity/liquid_glass_raster.[ch] with an exact general-resolution postguard batch constructor and explicit diagnostics; reuse its existing C23 128-bit dyadic machinery.
Generalize shaders/reveal_mask.frag.glsl with BaseOwnerSlotCount and seam-locked child sampling, while keeping one native geometry draw.
In walle.c, construct base plus supported children before upload, upload one combined axis table, and keep unsupported children on explicit base ownership.
Resize the shared axis texture for active combined owner rows; do not add a compute program, staging texture, framebuffer, or per-output compute resource.
Update the standalone GLES gate to call the same batch API and shader, then freeze the 91-pixel inventory on both GPUs.
Update the corpus expectation from 141 to 91 and the process-gate candidate inventory from 787d00a0...a3 to 9062b7bf...3644 only after general-size and lifecycle gates pass.
requiredTests: Exact clip-unit vectors for target extents 1,2,3,5,7,255,257,1023,2047,2048,2049,4095 and asymmetric width/height combinations.
Vertices exactly on, one binary32 ULP inside, and one ULP outside each -extent/4 and 5*extent/4 guard plane.
Empty, degenerate, triangle, quad, and maximum seven-vertex clip output with canonical fan and overlap order.
Tiny/odd scissor rectangles, fully off-scissor children, resize/hotplug/context recreation, and nondefault GL state.
Failure injection for allocation, packed-size overflow, owner-capacity overflow, malformed indices, and known unsupported non-axis children.
Cross-architecture candidate equality under altered floating-point environment and contraction settings.
Full65 iGPU/RX9070 score, ordinary GLES gate, actual-process capture gate, GCC analyzer, ASan/UBSan with -fno-wrapv, and TSan on renderer-owned state.
